page.layout: One page: a single calendar table with a running head at the top and a page number at the top right. Columns from left to right: Indict., An. Iul., Lit. dom., Nabon., Feriæ, the Mart. notes beside the Feriæ column, and Christi. Horizontal rules divide the table into three sections. A gathering signature sits at the foot, centred.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | | Christi.

page.notes: The page number is printed in old-style figures ("46s"), read as 465. The final Christi entry on the last row is partly obscured by the edge of the scan, but reads 693. Rows are grouped in three sections separated by printed rules. Empty cells in the Mart. column are left blank as printed.
